summary: This bill amends the McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act to allow Emergency Solutions Grants to be used for establishing and operating "safe parking" facilities, which provide homeless individuals living in vehicles with a secure place to park overnight and access to re-housing and supportive services.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the eligible activities for existing Emergency Solutions Grants under the McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act to include safe overnight parking facilities. While it doesn't authorize new funding, it directs how existing funds can be used, potentially increasing spending on these specific services within the existing grant program.

The bill expands the scope of services available under the McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act to include safe parking and associated re-housing and supportive services for homeless persons living in vehicles. This represents an expansion of the social safety net by providing new forms of assistance to a vulnerable population.
